queries.sql:
SELECT p.Id AS customerId,p.CategoryId AS categoryId,p.CustomerName AS customerName,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(c.Name,''),'未分类') AS categoryName,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS lastYearOrderAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek1,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek2,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek3,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek4,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek5,SUM(CASE WHEN o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s THEN o.OrderTotalPrice ELSE 0 END) AS orderWeek6
                FROM SaleOrder o JOIN Base_Partner p ON p.Id=o.CustomerId
                LEFT JOIN Base_Category c ON c.Id=p.CategoryId
                WHERE p.IsDeleted=0 AND o.Status<>%s
                AND ((o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s) OR (o.CreateTime >= %s AND o.CreateTime < %s))
                GROUP BY p.Id,p.CategoryId,p.CustomerName,c.Name

SELECT p.Id AS customerId,p.CategoryId AS categoryId,p.CustomerName AS customerName,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(c.Name,''),'未分类') AS categoryName,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.ReturnQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS returnAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*(d.DeliveryQuantity-d.ReturnQuantity) ELSE 0 END) AS januaryNetDeliveryAmount,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek1,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek2,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek3,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek4,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek5,SUM(CASE WHEN o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s THEN d.SalePrice*d.DeliveryQuantity ELSE 0 END) AS deliveryWeek6
                FROM DeliveryOrderDetail d JOIN DeliveryOrder o ON o.Id=d.DeliveryOrderId
                JOIN Base_Partner p ON p.Id=o.CustomerId LEFT JOIN Base_Category c ON c.Id=p.CategoryId
                WHERE p.IsDeleted=0 AND d.IsDeleted=0 AND d.IsOutboundInventory=1
                AND ((o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s) OR (o.DeliveryTime >= %s AND o.DeliveryTime < %s))
                GROUP BY p.Id,p.CategoryId,p.CustomerName,c.Name
